categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of LED backlight display modules primarily used in LCD screens. Its products are widely applied in mid-to-small size displays for tablets, gaming devices, smartphones, automotive displays, medical instruments, industrial control displays, home appliances, and other consumer electronics. The company focuses on mid-sized LED backlight modules and is expanding its product applications to include tablets, gaming, and smartphones.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced vacuum compression molding technology for light guide plates, which enhances optical performance and production efficiency. It employs precision mold design, CNC machining, AOI optical inspection, SMT surface mount technology, and automated assembly lines with CCD visual alignment and optical brightness testing. The production process is highly customized and follows a make-to-order model, supported by ERP and PMC systems for material control and production planning.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are downstream LCD display module manufacturers, including leading firms such as Qunzhiguangdian, Huaxing Optoelectronics, and Xinli Optoelectronics. End markets include major global brands like Nintendo, OPPO, VIVO, Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung, LG, Lenovo, Haier, Midea, Honeywell, Panasonic, Canon, BYD, and SAIC. The company serves diverse industries including consumer electronics, automotive, medical, industrial control, and home appliances.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for over 50% of revenue, and has a growing international presence with exports contributing nearly 48% of revenue. It has subsidiaries in Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Jiangxi Province. The global supply chain and customer base span Asia and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the LED industry supply chain, producing LED backlight display modules that serve as critical components for LCD display modules. It procures raw materials such as FPC, LED chips, optical films, and plastics, and supplies finished backlight modules to LCD module manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in LED backlight technology, including Mini-LED and Micro-LED development, optical microstructure design, and advanced molding techniques. It invests in R&D to enhance product performance, energy efficiency, and customization capabilities, aiming to expand into mid-sized display markets and new application fields such as automotive and medical displays. The company also plans to strengthen its global market presence and accelerate commercialization of new display technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized LED backlight display modules to LCD display module manufacturers. The company follows a make-to-order production model, pricing products based on material costs plus reasonable margins, adjusted for market conditions and customer specifications. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Ruiyi Optoelectronics, Japan Meibeiya Group, Weizhi Holdings, Dongguan Sanxie Precision Technology, Shenzhen Baoming Technology, Shenzhen Longli Technology, and Shenzhen Shanben Optoelectronics. The company is positioned as one of the leading enterprises in the LED backlight display module industry in China, with strong R&D, quality control, and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 457 million, a slight decrease of 2.5% from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 20.6 million, marking a significant turnaround from prior losses. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.5 billion and equity of RMB 1.08 billion, showing stable financial scale with improving profitability and operational efficiency. The company’s R&D expenses accounted for 5.76% of revenue, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced vacuum compression molding technology for light guide plates, enabling superior optical performance, brightness, and uniformity in backlight modules. It offers highly customized solutions tailored to client specifications, supported by a complete in-house production process from materials to assembly, ensuring quality and cost control. Its strong customer base and long-term partnerships with leading LCD module manufacturers and global brands underscore its reliability and technical leadership in the LED backlight display market.
